secondary_areas_uncovered.area: Common component — IacRegistryLinks visible outline buttons
secondary_areas_uncovered.note: Terraform/OpenTofu registry links are now visible outline buttons (labeled, not hover-only). Rendered in the Alerts list toolbar (#actions-overflow, data-test=alert-list-iac-registries) and the SLO list. No E2E spec currently asserts these; a good home is alerts-ui-operations.spec.js (Alerts list chrome) or a common-component spec. Out of scope for this run's dominant feature (anomaly sensitivity labeling).

rationale: The diff's dominant feature is anomaly-detection sensitivity labeling, whose E2E home is already tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Alerts/alerts-anomaly-detection.spec.js. The dev already updated the existing 'hint names the percentile' test for the p97→97% reword (the interpolation is now asserted), so that behavior needs no new test. What remains uncovered in the anomaly wizard is: the 'Percentile'→'Level' label rename, the new percentile info tooltip (sensitivityNotDataPercentile), the new preview caption (previewCaption), and the new detection-function explainer tooltip. All four live inside the same anomaly wizard this spec already drives, so the least-duplicative action is to append new test() blocks to that spec rather than spawn a new file. No registration needed (append to an already-registered spec). The IacRegistryLinks visible-button change is a distinct common-component area and is noted as a secondary area, not folded into this anomaly spec.
